questions.question: In December 2024, the Constitutional Court annulled a provision of the Brussels taxi ordinance of 9 June 2022, for lack of a cooperation agreement between the Regions. Until what date at the latest did the Court maintain the effects of that provision?
questions.explanation: Judgment No. 154/2024 of 19 December 2024 maintains the effects until the cooperation agreement, required by the special law since 1993, enters into force, and until 30 June 2027 at the latest. On 9 June 2026, negotiations between the Regions had not begun.

questions.question: What are the three cumulative conditions that the Brussels organic ordinance of 6 October 2016 sets for a statistical sector to be included in the urban revitalisation zone (ZRU)?
options: A lower median income, older buildings and more vacant homes than the regional reference values
A higher unemployment rate, fewer green spaces and more social homes than the regional reference values
A higher density, older buildings and a higher poverty rate than the regional reference values
A lower median income, and a higher density and unemployment rate than the regional reference values
questions.explanation: The three criteria are relative: each statistical sector is compared with the most recent regional values. Sustainable neighbourhood contracts and urban renovation contracts are run within the zone defined in this way.
